links.outcome: Expert-rated clinical concordance of AI comments and management suggestions on ICU ABG cases
links.effect: Concordant in 93.1% of cases (95% CI 91.6-94.4); over 96% in renal, metabolic and sepsis subgroups; lower in hematologic and malignancy subgroups.
links.quote: Clinical comments and management suggestions were rated concordant in 93.1% of cases (95% CI: 91.6-94.4).

unlisted_practices: Rule-based formula-guided LLM prompting with explicit physiologic equations to constrain calculations

screen.reason: The study evaluates the concordance of an LLM-based framework (ChatGPT combined with explicit physiological equations) for interpreting arterial blood gases on retrospective ICU data, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparison.
